stories.title: Resend verification email button
stories.description: As a new user, I want a resend verification email button that appears after 60 seconds of waiting, so that I can re-trigger email verification if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Button appears after 60 seconds on email verification step
Clicking the button sends a new verification email immediately
stories.source_reference: Add a 'resend verification email' button that appears after 60 seconds of waiting.

stories.title: Google OAuth sign-up alternative
stories.description: As a user, I want to sign up with Google OAuth as an alternative to email/password, so that I can register quickly using my existing Google account.
acceptance_criteria: Google OAuth button present on sign-up screen
Successful OAuth login creates user account and logs in
stories.source_reference: Allow users to sign up with Google OAuth as an alternative to email/password.

stories.title: Progress indicator during onboarding
stories.description: As a new user, I want to see a progress indicator (step 1 of 3) so that I know how long onboarding takes.
acceptance_criteria: Progress indicator displays 'Step 1 of 3' at start of onboarding
Indicator updates as user progresses through onboarding steps
stories.source_reference: Show a progress indicator (step 1 of 3) so users know how long onboarding takes.

stories.title: Turn off specific notification categories
stories.description: As a user, I want to turn off specific notification categories (comments, mentions, reminders), so that I can reduce notification overload.
acceptance_criteria: User can disable 'comments' notifications in settings
stories.source_reference: Users must be able to turn off specific notification categories (comments, mentions, reminders).

stories.title: Sync notification preferences across devices
stories.description: As a user with multiple devices, I want my notification preferences to sync across devices within 30 seconds, so that I have a consistent experience.
acceptance_criteria: Preference change on one device reflects on another within 30 seconds
stories.source_reference: Preferences should sync across devices within 30 seconds.

stories.title: Pause all notifications for set duration
stories.description: As an enterprise user, I want a 'pause all notifications' option for a set duration (1h, 8h, 24h), so that I can temporarily silence notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications automatically resume after selected duration
stories.source_reference: A 'pause all notifications' option for a set duration (1h, 8h, 24h) was requested by three enterprise customers.

stories.title: Implement feed pagination
stories.description: As a user browsing the activity feed, I want the feed to load 20 items initially and fetch more on scroll, so that initial load is faster.
acceptance_criteria: Scrolling triggers fetch of next 20 items
stories.source_reference: Implement pagination (load 20 items, fetch more on scroll) instead of loading everything.

stories.title: Cache last-seen feed state locally
stories.description: As a user opening the activity feed, I want the last-seen feed state cached locally so that the UI renders immediately on open, so that I don't wait for server data.
acceptance_criteria: Last-seen state stored locally on device
UI renders immediately using cached state on subsequent opens
stories.source_reference: Cache the last-seen feed state locally so the UI renders immediately on open.

stories.title: Lazy load avatar images in feed
stories.description: As a user browsing the activity feed, I want avatar images to load only when they scroll into view, so that initial feed load is faster.
acceptance_criteria: Avatar images load only when scrolled into view
stories.source_reference: Defer loading of avatar images until they scroll into view (lazy loading).

summary: Key requirements include redesigning user onboarding with a resend verification button, progress indicator, and deferred OAuth sign-up; enhancing notification settings with per-category controls, cross-device sync, and a pause duration feature; and optimizing activity feed performance via pagination, local caching, and lazy avatar loading to achieve under-1.5-second load times.
